_comment: Ground truth from human review. The judge in check.ts is tuned until it reproduces these verdicts. Without this the judge is unmeasured — the first version passed golf, swimming, gymnastics and volleyball that the user had rejected outright, and failed the ice-hockey frame the user approved. Add a case whenever a human verdict disagrees with the judge.

cases.why: no putting green at all; the floor carries teal lines echoing the set's own hexagons, and golf is visible only through a window at the back
no pool at all; basketball lines; blocks tiny at the right
apparatus tiny and shoved to the back; almost no floor markings
basketball court lines, no running lanes; blocks microscopic
no mat; prop is a grid of seats floating in the back window
net crushed against the right edge and cropped; markings nearly absent
basketball court lines again; floating steps
user approved — Nano Banana Pro + the layout field: pool lengthwise, lane ropes, blocks in a row at the far end. The lane-end cross T is standard competition marking, not a defect
